job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
A growing retail business in Crediton is looking to appoint a commercially minded Finance Manager to take ownership of its financial reporting, management information, and finance systems.

This is a hands-on role with genuine influence. You’ll sit at the heart of decision-making, ensuring the numbers don’t just add up but actively drive better performance across the business.

This is not a passive reporting role. It’s for someone who wants to improve how the business understands itself through data.

The Role

Reporting to the Finance Director, you will be responsible for:

  • Producing accurate and timely monthly management accounts (P&L, balance sheet and cashflow)
  • Delivering commercial insight to support trading, margin and stock decisions
  • Leading budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis
  • Developing and improving financial systems, reporting tools and data flows
  • Acting as the finance partner to operational and commercial teams
  • Ensuring strong financial controls, reconciliations and audit readiness
  • Driving automation and process improvement within finance
  • Managing and developing junior finance staff (where applicable)

This role suits someone who enjoys getting under the bonnet of the numbers and the systems behind them, not just reporting performance, but improving how it’s measured and used.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in a Finance Manager / Management Accountant type role
  • Background in retail, FMCG, wholesale or a similar fast-moving environment
  • Strong systems and data capability – comfortable improving ERP, reporting, Excel/BI tools and workflows
  • Commercially minded, with the ability to translate data into action
  • Hands-on, pragmatic and comfortable in a growing, evolving business
  • Part or fully qualified (ACA / ACCA / CIMA), or qualified by experience

Why Join?

  • Play a key role in a £35m turnover retail business with real operational influence
  • High visibility with senior leadership
  • Opportunity to shape systems, reporting and the future finance function
  • A business that values finance as a strategic partner, not a back-office function
  • Competitive salary and benefits, depending on experience

Gravitate values a diverse workforce. Women, people of colour, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQ+ community are strongly encouraged to apply

job.title: Management Accountant
job.description:
We're partnering with a highly regarded, values-led consumer brand to recruit a Management Accountant into a growing finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded accountant who enjoys getting into the detail, partnering with stakeholders and helping drive business performance.

The Opportunity

This role offers far more than month end reporting. You'll play a key role in providing insight to the wider business, improving processes and supporting strategic decision making within a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Preparing monthly management accounts for multiple entities
  • Producing meaningful analysis and commentary on performance
  • Supporting budgeting and forecasting processes
  • Monitoring performance against budget and highlighting risks and opportunities
  • Business partnering with operational teams across the organisation
  • Conducting cost and profitability analysis
  • Supporting process improvements and finance automation initiatives
  • Assisting with audit requirements and ensuring strong financial controls and compliance.

About You

We're keen to speak with individuals who are:
  • ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified or part-qualified
  • Experienced in preparing management accounts within a fast-paced environment
  • Strong users of Excel and finance systems
  • Commercially minded and naturally curious
  • Confident communicating with both finance and non-finance stakeholders
  • Proactive, hands-on and keen to improve processes
  • Comfortable working independently whilst also being a collaborative team player.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a purpose-led business that genuinely invests in its people and encourages continuous learning and development. You'll be joining a supportive team where ideas are welcomed, collaboration is encouraged and you'll have the chance to make a visible impact from day one.

job.title: Group Financial Controller
job.description:
Bring order to complexity. Turn fragmented reporting into something the business can actually rely on.

We’re working with a private equity backed group that has grown quickly across multiple entities. The opportunity now is to tighten financial control, standardise reporting, and give leadership a clearer view of performance across the group.

This is a Group Financial Controller role, sitting underneath a senior finance leader, with real ownership of the engine room. It’s ideal for someone who enjoys structure, accuracy, and improving how finance actually works day to day.
This is a Cheltenham-based role with hybrid working.

The role

You’ll be responsible for group-level financial control and reporting across a growing portfolio of businesses.
This role is about consistency, discipline, and delivery.

Your focus will include:

  • Leading the monthly close across multiple entities
  • Producing consolidated management accounts and group reporting
  • Improving balance sheet control, reconciliations, and audit readiness
  • Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and reforecasting cycles
  • Strengthening financial controls and standardising processes across the group
  • Managing statutory accounts and coordinating external auditors
  • Supporting integration of newly acquired businesses from a finance perspective
  • Acting as a reliable point of contact for operational teams on finance matters

You’ll be close to the detail, but with enough exposure to understand how the group fits together.

What they’re looking for

This role will suit someone who:

  • Is a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, or CIMA)
  • Has strong group reporting and consolidation experience
  • Has worked in a multi-entity or PE-backed environment
  • Is methodical, dependable, and comfortable owning deadlines
  • Can improve processes without overcomplicating them
  • Enjoys being the person others rely on for accurate numbers

You don’t need to be a strategic visionary. You do need to be technically strong and consistent.

Why this role?

  • Because the business needs proper control as it scales.
  • Because you’ll be trusted with real responsibility, not just tasks.
  • Because there’s scope to grow as the group continues to evolve.

If you’re a Financial Controller who enjoys getting things right and improving how finance runs behind the scenes, this is worth a conversation.

Gravitate values a diverse workforce. Women, people of colour, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQ community are strongly encouraged to apply.

job.title: Head Of Group Finance
job.description:
This is not a steady-state Head of Finance role. This is the number one finance position in a private equity-backed services platform executing an ambitious buy-and-build strategy across environmental and infrastructure markets.

The business is already trading at c.£50m revenue, profitable, acquisitive and equity-funded. The next phase is about scale, leverage and professionalisation.

They now need a Head of Finance to sit at the heart of that journey.

Not a caretaker.

A builder.

The role

You will be the senior finance leader in the group, reporting directly to the MD and working closely with the operators, driving acquisitions and integration.

This is a hands-on leadership role. There is no large central finance team. You will build structure, rigour and reporting discipline as the platform scales.

Your remit will include:

  • Full ownership of group reporting and consolidation across multiple entities
  • Delivering accurate monthly management accounts with pace and credibility
  • Strengthening financial controls and governance across subsidiaries
  • Leading budgeting, forecasting and scenario modelling
  • Treasury and cash management in an acquisitive environment
  • Supporting due diligence, deal execution and post-acquisition integration
  • Managing lenders, debt facilities and covenant reporting
  • Acting as a commercial partner to leadership on growth and investment decisions
  • Building and developing a scalable finance function over time

In the first 6–12 months, success will look like:

  • Consolidated reporting delivered early in the month
  • Clean, robust numbers trusted by lenders and investors
  • Clear visibility on cash and working capital
  • A repeatable finance integration playbook for bolt-on acquisitions
  • A finance function that feels structured rather than reactive

This appointment will materially influence enterprise value.

Your profile

You are likely:
  • ACA / ACCA / CIMA qualified
  • Technically strong in group consolidation, audit and statutory reporting
  • Comfortable with UK GAAP and complex accounting areas (acquisition accounting, intercompany, revenue recognition)
  • Experienced in a high-growth, PE-backed or leveraged environment
  • Exposed to M&A, either through due diligence or integration
  • Commercially sharp — not just technically capable

You may currently be:
  • A Group Financial Controller in a £20–80m business
  • A divisional finance lead ready for your first true #1 finance seat
  • A strong Financial Controller stepping into a broader leadership mandate

What matters most is mindset.

This business needs someone comfortable creating structure from ambiguity. Someone who can operate at pace. Someone ambitious enough to grow into a future CFO.

The opportunity

  • Base salary circa £120,000 – £140,000 (flexible for exceptional candidates)
  • Performance bonus aligned to growth
  • Future meaningful equity participation
  • Hybrid working model
  • Direct exposure to investors and deal activity
  • Clear pathway toward CFO as the platform scales

If you want a comfortable corporate role with layers of support and zero risk, this is not it.
If you want to build something properly and be rewarded for it, this will appeal.

This is an exclusive search managed by Gravitate Recruitment. If you would like a confidential conversation, please get in touch directly.

Gravitate values a diverse workforce. Women, people of colour, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQ community are strongly encouraged to apply.
